title: Hunts FH-031T: Gate the completion reward and the Event stop on the finale seat
detail:
FH-031S put the finale on the screens (the Trail editor's finale pick frozen at publish as hunt_versions.policy.finale.event_id, and the player's finale panel from loadRallyFinale). Still owed: (1) the first route that grants a completion reward calls grantFinaleReward with the run's projection, and hunt_reward_grant gets the same seat check in SQL (a succeeded unrefunded ticket or an admitted going RSVP at the version's finale Event) so the rule does not rest on one caller. That SQL change is a new migration, which the FH-031S pass was not allowed to write; it goes through the serialized migration gate (docs/DATABASE.md). (2) An Event stop credits through hunt_claim_apply with finaleDoorEvidence at assurance event_door. (3) Owner check on a preview deployment: a finished player with no seat at a full host Event sees the full message and holds no RSVP, ticket or reward afterwards. Requires FH-021 and FH-030. Hunts switches stay OFF.

Built 2026-11-16. Reward: app/(main)/hunts/[slug]/play/finale-actions.ts collectFinaleRewardAction reads the finale for the signed-in player's run (loadRallyFinale) and asks through grantFinaleReward, so a player the Event has not admitted never reaches the database. Migration 20270346086000_hunt_finale_reward_gate.sql redefines hunt_reward_grant from 20270346042000 (same signature, grants and comment) with the seat check in SQL: when the run's version names policy.finale.event_id, a grant needs a succeeded unrefunded ticket or a going RSVP not pending approval at that Event, held by the caller, and the Event published, not cancelled and not removed; otherwise it answers not_admitted (reason no_seat or event_unavailable) and writes nothing, not even the key. pgTAP: supabase/tests/hunt_finale_reward_gate.test.sql. Event stop: checkInAtFinaleAction credits the version's Event stop (the one mission bound to a live placement of medium event, lib/hunts/finale-store.ts loadFinaleStop) through hunt_claim_apply with finaleDoorEvidence at assurance event_door, the existing evidence path; a self check-in is not evidence. Both taps render from components/hunts/finale-claims.tsx on the Trail page, behind HUNTS_REWARDS_ENABLED and HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED. Not applied anywhere. Filed: FH-031U (owner check on a preview deployment) and FH-031V (an author path that places an Event stop; nothing writes a medium event placement yet).
